intent: validation screen (no candidate change, no upload)

measure_before.limitation: it reports the ratio and the excluded network systems but does not resolve whether an implementation or interpretation mismatch remains

method.L_named: sum of EPSG:5070 clipped lengths of provided Overture road segments whose class is in motorway,primary,secondary,trunk, counted for every such segment
method.L_route: sum of EPSG:5070 clipped lengths of provided Overture road segments with at least one routes[].network value in a kept family, counted once per segment (deduplicated by segment row; per-family lengths may overlap)
method.aggregate_ratio: sum(L_named) / sum(L_route) over the official scored tracts of the region
dropped: unsupported_us_network (unknown state token, county-name namespaces, numbered-only state namespaces, non-highway systems)
method.deduplication: one segment row contributes to L_route once regardless of how many kept families or route entries it carries; family columns overlap by construction and are only used for attribution, never summed into L_route
method.clip: shapely intersection of the WGS84 segment with the official tract polygon, then lengths in EPSG:5070
method.disjoint_classes: A = named and route, B = named without route, C = route without named; ratio = (A+B)/(A+C); ratio > 1 exactly when B > C
method.independent_implementation: own classifier, own clip/accumulate loop, own aggregation; the frozen module is imported only to compare the rule constant sets

rule_constants.comparison_purpose: the measurement path never imports the frozen module; these sets are loaded only to report whether the two implementations encode the same rule
rule_constants.note_non_route_systems: the frozen classifier drops US:NHS and US:NFRS explicitly and routes US:NFSR through the excluded-system token list; the independent classifier lists NHS and NFRS as non-route systems and NFSR/NFRS as excluded system tokens, and both reject the same observed strings (verified string-by-string in network_string_agreement)

diagnosis.reading: Maricopa: A (named and route-qualified) = 11146.389 km, B (named class with no kept network entry) = 10967.324 km, C (route-qualified but not named class) = 320.165 km; the ratio exceeds 1 exactly when B exceeds C, i.e. the numerator counts arterial-class length the denominator cannot see because every route entry on those segments was rejected by the frozen network filter. | maricopa-az: B-C = 10647.158 km, ratio 1.928540324, band FAIL | northern-ca: B-C = 4086.905 km, ratio 1.503515380, band PASS | eastern-ok: B-C = 3872.117 km, ratio 1.160856228, band PASS | south-central-tx: B-C = 18282.298 km, ratio 1.183016822, band PASS
diagnosis.band_action: the frozen 0.6-1.7 band is kept unchanged and the Maricopa failure is reported as unresolved; no rule was relaxed and no excluded network system was added to force the ratio into band

conclusion.mechanism: definition plus provided-data coverage, not an implementation mismatch: L_named counts every arterial-class segment while L_route counts only segments carrying a kept routes[].network value, so the ratio is governed by how much arterial length carries no usable route reference

dominant_bucket.meaning: named-class segments whose routes array is empty, which the route denominator can never include without abandoning the meaning of a route-reference proxy

conclusion.recommended_next_step: the Maricopa transport component is near-degenerate (almost every defined tract clips to gap 0), so any future change to the route denominator must be a separately pre-registered candidate decision with its own hypothesis and operator authorization; this diagnostic adopts no change
